h2: Pool Cleaning Ubud – One-Off Service & Green Pool Recovery
intro: Ubud's jungle canopy, river-valley humidity and constant leaf fall mean pools here clog and cloud faster than anywhere on the island. Bali Fix handles one-off pool cleaning Ubud villa owners need before guests arrive, after a green-water scare, or when well-water minerals have scaled up the filter. Send photos on WhatsApp and get a clear quote for the job.

sections.h3: Why Pools in Ubud Need More Attention Than Coastal Villas
sections.text: The dense tree cover drops leaves into every skimmer and gutter daily, while persistent humidity keeps chlorine levels drifting between checks. Villas in Sayan and Tegallalang sit on slopes where spring and well water carries extra minerals that coat filter media quickly. A single busy week can turn crystal-clear water cloudy or faintly green long before your next guest arrives at the gate.

sections.h3: What a One-Off Visit Actually Covers
sections.text: Skimming, brushing all surfaces, vacuuming the basin, backwashing the cartridge or sand unit and rebalancing chlorine, pH and alkalinity are standard in every visit. If the water has gone green or milky after a dry spell we treat it as a recovery job—shock dosing, deep brush, extended filtration run. Waterline tile staining from hard well water is another frequent request around Penestanan.

sections.h3: How to Get a Quote via WhatsApp
sections.text: Send two or three clear photos showing the pool surface, the waterline tiles and the filter housing to our WhatsApp line. Note whether you draw from a well, spring or mains supply, how many days have passed since the last clean, and any upcoming arrival dates. From those images we put together a straightforward quote so you know exactly what the visit covers before anyone walks up to your gate.

sections.h3: Prevention Tips for Ubud's Jungle Climate
sections.text: Empty skimmer baskets every other day rather than weekly—the leaf load here simply outpaces a once-a-week rhythm. A fine mesh cover over the main drain cuts the daily debris that clogs filters in Nyuh Kuning and Peliatan. After heavy rain, run the pump an extra hour to flush trapped sediment, and check free chlorine twice a week through the wet season so algae never gets a foothold between professional cleans.

faq.q: How long does a green-pool recovery take?
faq.a: Most recoveries are handled in a single visit with shock treatment, thorough brushing and an extended filtration run, though heavily stained basins sometimes benefit from a follow-up pass. Send photos first and we'll tell you realistically what to expect.

faq.q: Does well or spring water change how often I should book a clean?
faq.a: Mineral-rich well water scales filter media faster and shifts pH more unpredictably than mains supply, so many Ubud villas find a two-weekly cadence keeps things stable. Regular backwashing helps, but a professional chemistry check catches drift early.

faq.q: Can you also inspect my UV steriliser or cartridge filter?
faq.a: Filter backwash and a visual inspection of the cartridge or sand unit come standard with every pool clean. If your villa runs a UV system on well water, mention it when booking and we'll include a quick function check during the same visit.
